<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">⚠️ 法律与伦理声明<span>：本文所述技术仅适用于您拥有或获得明确书面授权的系统<span>，包括个人实验环境、CTF 比赛、TryHackMe/HackTheBox 等合法靶场。未经授权对他人系统进行密码破解属于违法行为。</span></span></p>
</blockquote>
<h2><span>一、Kali 自带字典资源：/usr/share/wordlists/</span></h2>
<h3><span>1.1 目录结构与核心字典</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Kali 的字典主要存放在 <code>/usr/share/wordlists/</code><span> 下，包含多个符号链接指向各工具的专用字典<span>：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>/usr/share/wordlists/
├── rockyou.txt.gz          → 最核心的密码字典（压缩状态）
├── dirb/                   → Web 目录扫描字典
├── dirbuster/              → 目录爆破字典
├── john.lst                → John the Ripper 默认字典
├── nmap.lst                → Nmap 密码字典
├── metasploit/             → Metasploit 默认凭据字典
├── seclists/               → SecLists 综合字典集
└── wfuzz/                  → 参数模糊测试字典</pre>
</div>
<h3><span>1.2 解压 rockyou.txt（必做第一步）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>RockYou 字典以压缩包形式提供，需要先解压才能使用。解压后包含约 1434 万条<span>真实泄露密码，文件大小约 134MB<span>：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo gunzip /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt.gz
<span class="token function">wc <span class="token parameter variable">-l /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
<span class="token comment"># 输出约 14344392 行</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如后续需要按长度筛选（如仅保留 6 位密码），可使用：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">awk <span class="token string">'length($0) == 6' rockyou.txt <span class="token operator">&gt; rockyou-6.txt</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果字典不够用，可安装 <code>seclists</code><span> 扩展包：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install seclists
<span class="token function">ls /usr/share/seclists/Passwords/</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>二、自定义字典生成：crunch + cewl + hashcat 规则</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>通用字典如 rockyou.txt 只能覆盖“懒人密码”。真实目标（尤其是企业环境）的密码往往与组织名称、地名、年份等上下文高度相关。构建针对性字典<span>能大幅提升破解效率。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>2.1 crunch：基于模式生成字典</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>crunch 的核心命令格式为 <code>crunch &lt;最小长度&gt; &lt;最大长度&gt; &lt;字符集&gt;</code><span>。Kali 自带 charset 文件位于 <code>/usr/share/crunch/charset.lst</code><span>。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">示例 1：生成 8 位纯数字字典</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>crunch <span class="token number">8 <span class="token number">8 0123456789 <span class="token parameter variable">-o ~/digits8.txt</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">示例 2：使用内置字符集生成 6 位混合字典</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>crunch <span class="token number">6 <span class="token number">6 <span class="token parameter variable">-f /usr/share/crunch/charset.lst mixalpha-numeric <span class="token parameter variable">-o ~/mix6.txt</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">示例 3：基于已知模式生成（如“公司名+4位数字”）</p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>crunch <span class="token number">8 <span class="token number">8 abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz <span class="token parameter variable">-t @@@@@@@@ <span class="token parameter variable">-o ~/company8.txt</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>-t</code><span> 参数用 <code>@</code><span> 占位符表示位置，适合生成有固定结构的密码（如 PLDTWIFI 路由器默认密码 <code>PLDTWIFI@@@@@</code><span>）<span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">注意<span>：crunch 会生成完整组合，字典文件可能极大。建议先用 <code>-b</code><span> 限制输出文件大小，或用 <code>-l</code><span> 限制数量<span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>2.2 cewl：从目标网站抓取关键词</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果已掌握目标的网站信息，可用 cewl 抓取页面词汇生成基础字典：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>cewl <span class="token parameter variable">-d <span class="token number">2 <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">5 <span class="token parameter variable">-w ~/cewl_words.txt http://target-site.com
<span class="token comment"># -d 2: 爬取深度2层  -m 5: 最少5个字符的单词</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>2.3 hashcat 规则：对基础字典做变形扩展</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Hashcat 的规则引擎能对字典中的每个词自动生成大量变体（大小写变换、追加数字/符号、替换等），不需要在磁盘上存储所有变体<span>，效率远高于手工生成。</span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Kali 自带规则文件位于 <code>/usr/share/hashcat/rules/</code><span>，常用的有：</span></span></p>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>规则文件</span></th><th><span>说明</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>best64.rule</code></td>
<td><span>最常用的 64 条精简规则，速度快</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>rockyou-30000.rule</code></td>
<td><span>完整规则集，覆盖率高但耗时更长</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>d3ad0ne.rule</code></td>
<td><span>综合规则集</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">创建自定义规则文件<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 规则语法示例：首字母大写(c) + 追加"123"($1$2$3)
<span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token string">'c $1$2$3' <span class="token operator">&gt; ~/my.rule</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>每条规则占一行，<code>c</code><span> 表示首字母大写、其余小写，<code>$1</code><span> 表示追加字符 <code>1</code><span>，<code>^a</code><span> 表示前置字符 <code>a</code><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2><span>三、Hashcat：GPU 加速破解全流程</span></h2>
<h3><span>3.1 环境准备与 GPU 检测</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Hashcat 在 Kali 中可通过 apt 直接安装：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt update <span class="token operator">&amp;&amp; <span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y hashcat</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">检测 GPU 是否可用<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-I</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果输出中显示了 GPU 设备（如 NVIDIA CUDA 或 AMD OpenCL），则 GPU 加速已就绪。如果只显示 CPU，需要安装对应驱动。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">NVIDIA GPU 驱动安装<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install nvidia-driver nvidia-cuda-toolkit
<span class="token comment"># 重启后验证
nvidia-smi
hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-I</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">AMD GPU 驱动安装<span>：Kali 下 AMD 驱动配置较复杂，需要下载 AMD 官方 amdgpu-install 脚本并修改以适配 Kali 的软件源，或者安装 OpenCL 运行时<span>。如果 GPU 检测失败，可先用 <code>--force</code><span> 参数强制以 CPU 模式运行（速度慢很多）：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">0 hash.txt rockyou.txt <span class="token parameter variable">--force</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>3.2 哈希准备与识别</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>破解前需要确定哈希类型，Hashcat 用 <code>-m</code><span> 参数指定哈希模式。常见模式如下：</span></span></p>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>哈希类型</span></th><th><span>Hashcat 模式</span></th><th><span>示例</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>MD5</span></td>
<td><span>0</span></td>
<td><code>8743b52063cd84097a65d1633f5c74f5</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>SHA-256</span></td>
<td><span>1400</span></td>
<td><code>5e884898da...</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>NTLM</span></td>
<td><span>1000</span></td>
<td><span>Windows SAM 哈希</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>bcrypt</span></td>
<td><span>3200</span></td>
<td><code>$2y$12$...</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>NetNTLMv2</span></td>
<td><span>5600</span></td>
<td><span>网络捕获的响应</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>SHA-512 crypt</span></td>
<td><span>1800</span></td>
<td><span>Linux <code>/etc/shadow</code></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>准备哈希文件时，每行一个哈希<span>，不要包含用户名或其他前缀：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">echo <span class="token parameter variable">-n <span class="token string">"password123" <span class="token operator">| md5sum <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">awk <span class="token string">'{print $1}' <span class="token operator">&gt; ~/hash.txt
<span class="token function">cat ~/hash.txt
<span class="token comment"># 输出: 482c811da5d5b4bc6d497ffa98491e38</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>对于 Linux shadow 文件，需要先用 <code>unshadow</code><span> 合并 passwd 和 shadow，再提取哈希部分。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>3.3 字典攻击（Attack Mode 0）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>字典攻击是最基础也最常用的模式。核心命令格式<span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token operator">&lt;哈希模式<span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">0 <span class="token operator">&lt;哈希文件<span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token operator">&lt;字典路径<span class="token operator">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">实战示例：MD5 + rockyou<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">0 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">0 ~/hash.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">NTLM + rockyou + 规则增强<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">1000 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">0 ~/ntlm_hashes.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">-r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/best64.rule <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">-o ~/cracked.txt</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>-r</code><span> 指定规则文件，<code>-o</code><span> 指定破解结果输出文件。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>3.4 掩码暴力破解（Attack Mode 3）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>当已知密码的部分结构（如“4 位小写字母 + 2 位数字”）时，掩码攻击比盲目暴力高效得多。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">掩码占位符<span>：</span></p>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>占位符</span></th><th><span>含义</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>?l</code></td>
<td><span>小写字母 a-z</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>?u</code></td>
<td><span>大写字母 A-Z</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>?d</code></td>
<td><span>数字 0-9</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>?s</code></td>
<td><span>特殊字符</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>?a</code></td>
<td><span>所有可见字符</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">示例：破解“4 位小写字母 + 2 位数字”的 MD5<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">0 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">3 ~/hash.txt <span class="token string">'?l?l?l?l?d?d'</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>示例：用 <code>--increment</code><span> 自动递增长度<span>，从 1 位尝试到 6 位：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">1000 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">3 ~/ntlm_hashes.txt <span class="token string">'?a?a?a?a?a?a' <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">--increment --increment-min<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">1 --increment-max<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">6</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这会把掩码拆分，先尝试 1 位、再 2 位……直到 6 位，避免一次性枚举完整的大空间<span>。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>3.5 混合攻击（Attack Mode 6/7）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>混合攻击 = 字典 + 掩码，适合“常见单词 + 固定长度数字后缀”的模式。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">字典 + 数字后缀（Mode 6）<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">1000 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">6 ~/ntlm_hashes.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt ?d?d?d?d</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这会对 rockyou 中的每个词追加 4 位数字。注意<span>：完整的 rockyou 有 1400 万条，乘以 10000 种后缀 = 1400 亿候选，耗时极长。建议先用精简字典测试：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">head <span class="token parameter variable">-n <span class="token number">10000 /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt <span class="token operator">&gt; ~/mini.txt
hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">1000 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">6 ~/ntlm_hashes.txt ~/mini.txt ?d?d?d?d</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>3.6 结果查看与管理</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Hashcat 会将破解结果保存在 potfile（默认 <code>~/.hashcat/hashcat.potfile</code><span>）。查看已破解的哈希：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">--show <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">0 ~/hash.txt</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">恢复中断的会话<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">--restore</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">运行基准测试<span>（评估 GPU 性能）：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-b</span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>四、John the Ripper：字典与暴力破解</span></h2>
<h3><span>4.1 核心用法</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>John the Ripper（JtR）是另一款经典破解工具，Kali 预装的是 Jumbo 版本（功能更完整）。基本语法<span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>john <span class="token punctuation">[选项<span class="token punctuation">] <span class="token punctuation">[哈希文件<span class="token punctuation">]</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">自动尝试<span>（按 single → wordlist → incremental 顺序）：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>john hashes.txt</pre>
</div>
<h3><span>4.2 字典模式</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">基本字典攻击<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>john <span class="token parameter variable">--wordlist<span class="token operator">=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt hashes.txt</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">指定哈希格式<span>（推荐，避免自动识别失败）：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># MD5
john <span class="token parameter variable">--format<span class="token operator">=raw-md5 <span class="token parameter variable">--wordlist<span class="token operator">=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt hashes.txt

<span class="token comment"># Linux shadow (sha512crypt)
john <span class="token parameter variable">--format<span class="token operator">=sha512crypt <span class="token parameter variable">--wordlist<span class="token operator">=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt unshadowed.txt</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">字典 + 规则<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>john <span class="token parameter variable">--wordlist<span class="token operator">=/usr/share/john/password.lst <span class="token parameter variable">--rules unshadowed.txt</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>John 的规则系统会基于字典词生成变形，类似于 Hashcat 的 <code>-r</code><span> 规则<span>。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>4.3 暴力破解（Incremental 模式）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>John 的 <code>--incremental</code><span> 模式是最强大的暴力破解方式，会尝试指定字符集内的所有组合<span>：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 使用默认字符集
john <span class="token parameter variable">--incremental hashes.txt

<span class="token comment"># 仅使用字母
john <span class="token parameter variable">--incremental:alpha hashes.txt

<span class="token comment"># 仅使用数字
john <span class="token parameter variable">--incremental:digits hashes.txt</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">指定格式<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>john <span class="token parameter variable">--incremental <span class="token parameter variable">--format<span class="token operator">=raw-sha256 hashes.txt</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">查看已破解结果<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>john <span class="token parameter variable">--show hashes.txt</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>4.4 Linux Shadow 文件破解流程</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>从 Linux 系统中提取的 shadow 文件需要与 passwd 合并后交给 John：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>unshadow /etc/passwd /etc/shadow <span class="token operator">&gt; ~/unshadowed.txt
john <span class="token parameter variable">--wordlist<span class="token operator">=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt <span class="token parameter variable">--format<span class="token operator">=sha512crypt ~/unshadowed.txt</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果系统使用 <code>crypt</code><span> 格式（旧系统），可尝试：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>john <span class="token parameter variable">--wordlist<span class="token operator">=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt <span class="token parameter variable">--format<span class="token operator">=crypt ~/unshadowed.txt</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>4.5 Single Crack 模式</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Single 模式利用用户名、GECOS 信息（全名、办公室等）生成猜测，适合快速尝试弱密码：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>john <span class="token parameter variable">--single <span class="token parameter variable">--format<span class="token operator">=sha512crypt hashes.txt</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>要求哈希文件中包含用户名前缀，格式为 <code>mike:$6$...</code><span>。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>五、GPU 加速配置要点</span></h2>
<h3><span>5.1 确认 GPU 被正确识别</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-I</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>输出中应显示类似：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>Device #1: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  Type: GPU
  Memory: 12288 MB</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果没有 GPU 设备显示，Hashcat 会回退到 CPU 模式，速度差异可达数十倍。</span></p>
<h3><span>5.2 提升性能的关键参数</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>参数</span></th><th><span>作用</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>-O</code></td>
<td><span>启用优化内核（限制密码最大长度，提升速度）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>-w 3</code></td>
<td><span>设置工作负载为高（0-4，越高越激进）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--force</code></td>
<td><span>强制运行（忽略警告，仅在不支持的环境下使用）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>-d 1</code></td>
<td><span>指定使用设备编号（多 GPU 时）</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">推荐组合<span>：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">1000 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">0 hashes.txt rockyou.txt <span class="token parameter variable">-O <span class="token parameter variable">-w <span class="token number">3</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>5.3 常见问题排查</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">OpenCL 错误<span>：NVIDIA 用户需安装 <code>nvidia-cuda-toolkit</code><span>，AMD 用户需安装 ROCm 或 OpenCL 运行时</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">旧 GPU 性能受限<span>：CUDA 计算能力低于 5.0（Maxwell 之前）的 GPU 性能会显著降低</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Kali 虚拟机中 GPU 不可用<span>：VM 通常无法直接访问物理 GPU，建议在宿主机运行或配置 GPU 直通</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>六、完整实战流程总结</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>以破解一个 NTLM 哈希为例：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token comment"># 1. 准备哈希
<span class="token function">cat <span class="token operator">&gt; ~/ntlm.txt <span class="token operator">&lt;&lt; <span class="token string">'EOF'
aad3b435b51404eeaad3b435b51404ee:31d6cfe0d16ae931b73c59d7e0c089c0
EOF

<span class="token comment"># 2. 解压字典（如未解压）
<span class="token function">sudo gunzip <span class="token parameter variable">-k /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt.gz <span class="token operator"><span class="token file-descriptor important">2&gt;/dev/null

<span class="token comment"># 3. GPU 检测
hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-I

<span class="token comment"># 4. 字典攻击 + best64 规则
hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">1000 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">0 ~/ntlm.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">-r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/best64.rule <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">-o ~/cracked.txt <span class="token parameter variable">-O

<span class="token comment"># 5. 查看结果
hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">--show <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">1000 ~/ntlm.txt

<span class="token comment"># 6. 如果字典未命中，尝试掩码暴力（1-6位）
hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">1000 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token number">3 ~/ntlm.txt <span class="token string">'?a?a?a?a?a?a' <span class="token punctuation">\
  <span class="token parameter variable">--increment --increment-min<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">1 --increment-max<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">6 <span class="token parameter variable">-O

<span class="token comment"># 7. 用 John 交叉验证（可选）
john <span class="token parameter variable">--format<span class="token operator">=nt <span class="token parameter variable">--wordlist<span class="token operator">=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt ~/ntlm.txt</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">效率建议<span>：优先使用字典攻击 + 规则；仅在字典穷尽后才进入暴力/掩码模式。对于已知格式的密码（如 WPA 的 8 位纯数字），掩码攻击是最高效的选择。混合攻击（字典+掩码）适合“单词+数字后缀”的常见模式，但需注意字典规模对总时间的影响。</span></p>

</div>
